feedback: The current code base implements many of the site’s static content and layout, and the acceptance tests pass for those parts. However, several critical pages (Contact, Training, NotFound) are not implemented in the repository, so the required functionality for the contact form, training filter, and 404 page is missing. Implement those pages and ensure all specified UI elements, accessibility attributes, and form behavior are present to satisfy the remaining requirements.
unproven: Missing NotFoundPage implementation: The file src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx exists but its content is not shown; likely not implemented, causing the NotFound route to not render an h1 "Page not found" and a link back to home as required by R109 and R110. Implement a NotFoundPage component that displays an h1 "Page not found" and a Link to '/' (home).

Missing ContactPage implementation: The file src/pages/ContactPage.tsx exists but its content is not shown; likely not implemented, causing the contact form and related logic (R92-R108) to be missing. Implement ContactPage with the required h1, email link, labelled form fields, validation using src/lib/contactForm, error messages, success message, and clearing of fields on successful submit.

Missing TrainingPage implementation detail: While src/pages/TrainingPage.tsx exists, its content is not shown; ensure it renders the h1 "Training", the filter buttons with proper aria-pressed handling, and course cards showing all required fields (title, audience, format, duration, learn list). Ensure the filter functionality updates the visible courses correctly.

Missing AboutPage content may be incomplete: Verify that the AboutPage fully implements the mission paragraph, Why Bayes paragraph, founder cards with placeholder tags, and values list as required. The current implementation includes these but needs to ensure the placeholder tags are clearly marked and visible for the tests.

Missing Header mobile behavior: The menu should close on Escape key press, but the current Header component adds a keydown listener only when the menu is open and closes on Escape; however, it does not return focus to the toggle or manage focus movement as required by accessibility. Add focus management to return focus to the menu button when the panel is closed via Escape.
